rationale: This is a clear motor vehicle collision with significant damage to the policyholder's vehicle and injury to the policyholder, all within auto coverage.
claim_summary: Rear-end collision on Route 9 at 8:15am yesterday; policyholder's vehicle is totaled with crush damage to trunk/back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver details available on police report. High-priority due to vehicle total loss and injury claims.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph, no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled, trunk crushed into back seat
